twc_results.takeaway: A real upset, not evidence that underdogs in general were mispriced. The very lopsided Nuke result is opponent-specific context, not a repeat-veto guarantee.
Falcons won; Ancient needed overtime. Do not mistake an underdog taking rounds for a series win.
Two close maps, including overtime on Mirage. A 2–0 does not measure the size of a future edge.
BETBOOM lost both maps after first-half leads. Those leads did not establish a calibrated upset probability.
Aurora recovered; NiP were eliminated. This argues against automatically fading Aurora after one upset.
Falcons qualified. 9z won Mirage and reached three maps, so the loss does not erase the upset case.
BETBOOM survived by reverse sweep; PARIVISION were eliminated. Winning an elimination match alone is not a reason to fade the next favorite.
FURIA qualified. Legacy took Cache before losing the series; assess opponent strength, not just the win/loss label.
